skills.name: Setup ICP e nichos
skills.description: Use on first install or whenever the owner wants to (re)define ICP, country, and search niches. Ask, suggest niches, confirm, then save. Do not hunt until niches are confirmed.
skills.content:
---
name: Setup ICP e nichos
description: >-
  Use on first install or whenever the owner wants to (re)define ICP, country,
  and search niches. Ask, suggest niches, confirm, then save. Do not hunt until
  niches are confirmed.
---
Run this on first use after import, or whenever the owner wants to redefine who they sell to. Do not start a Meta or Google hunt until niches are confirmed.

## 1. Ask about ICP

In the owner's language, ask:

- What they sell and to whom (industry, company size, buyer role)
- Country / region to search
- Language for recaps
- Niches they already know they want, and any to exclude
- Whether they want CRM now or later (GoHighLevel, HubSpot, or other)

Do not invent an ICP. If an answer is missing, ask.

## 2. Suggest niches

From the ICP, propose 8–15 Meta Ad Library niches as exact-phrase keywords a real advertiser would use. One line why each. Flag anything too broad or international-only.

Also propose Google Ads Transparency seeds per niche (distinctive company-name or domain fragments, not generic category words).

## 3. Confirm and save

The owner edits the list. Save to memory:

- ICP summary
- niches (exact phrases)
- country
- recap language
- gads terms (nicho → terms)
- excludes

## 4. CRM (optional in the same setup)

If they want CRM now, collect: type, auth via secret-request (never echo), destination (location / portal / pipeline / list), and a field map from name, phone, email, company, niche, city, state, website, instagram, source, tags.
If later, leave CRM unset and only deliver CSVs.

## Do not

- Hunt before the owner confirms niches
- Carry over another install's niches
- Send to CRM before type, auth, destination, and field map are set

skills.name: Meta Ads nichos
skills.description: Use when scanning Meta Ad Library by niche: pull the Advertiser filter list, enrich from public sources, then try first-load ad creatives via page_id for names still missing a phone.
skills.content:
---
name: Meta Ads nichos
description: >-
  Use when scanning Meta Ad Library by niche: pull the Advertiser filter list,
  enrich from public sources, then try first-load ad creatives via page_id for
  names still missing a phone.
---
Three steps per configured niche. Do not scroll the ad grid. Do not send to the CRM unless the owner asks or a routine says to.

## Setup
- URL: https://www.facebook.com/ads/library
- Country and niches come from agent memory. If niches are missing, ask before starting. If country is unset, ask.
- Category: All ads. Keyword: exact phrase.

## Hard rule
Never click See more / See more ads. Never infinite-scroll the creative grid. Box desktop is 1280×800.

## Step 1 — Advertiser filter listing
1. Search the niche as an exact phrase.
2. Filters → Advertiser. Scroll only inside that dropdown.
3. Extract unique names. Exclude "All advertisers". URL is blank.
4. The list is capped (~100). Save /workspace/meta-ads-{slug}-filtro.csv (Pagina,URL). Dated runs go under /workspace/meta-ads-YYYY-MM-DD/.

## Step 2 — public enrich
Official site, Maps, Instagram/Facebook About, professional registries. Do not invent. Homonyms stay blank. No registry-scraper-only phones. Tipo: escritorio|marketing|outro. Telefone E.164.
Save /workspace/meta-ads-{slug}-detalhes.csv (Nicho,Pagina,Tipo,Cidade,UF,Telefone,Site,Fonte,Obs).

## Step 3 — Ad Library creatives (only rows still missing a phone)
- Do not apply the Advertiser checkbox on the keyword search. That empties the grid.
- Typeahead is prefix-only. Search the name, read page_id from the option, do not apply.
- Open https://www.facebook.com/ads/library/?active_status=active&ad_type=all&country={COUNTRY}&view_all_page_id={PAGE_ID}
- Wait for first-load cards. Never See more.
- Take phones printed on the creative. Generic api.whatsapp.com/send (no phone param) is useless; the CTA is often disabled.
- Ad Library About is transparency only. facebook.com/{id} hits a login wall — do not log in.
- Capture landing/Instagram hrefs.

## Recurring
- Combined: /workspace/leads-meta-ads-nichos-YYYY-MM-DD.csv
- Baseline delta (nova / ja_vista by name+nicho) if leads-meta-ads-baseline.csv exists.
- Recap counts per niche.
- Do not use Google Maps scrapers or directory-hunt tools.

skills.name: Google Ads Transparency nichos
skills.description: Use when scanning Google Ads Transparency by niche: search the configured name/domain terms, take official-site phones first, then exact-name Google for leftover distinctive companies.
skills.content:
---
name: Google Ads Transparency nichos
description: >-
  Use when scanning Google Ads Transparency by niche: search the configured
  name/domain terms, take official-site phones first, then exact-name Google for
  leftover distinctive companies.
---
Complementary to Meta Ad Library. Transparency matches advertiser legal name or domain, not a niche keyword crawl.

## Terms
Read the configured term list from agent memory (nicho → search terms) and the configured country. If terms are missing, ask. Do not add overly broad or international-only terms.

## Harvest
Query Ads Transparency suggestions (advertiser name + domain). Keep advertisers in the configured country. Skip foreign TLDs. Deduplicate by advertiser id and domain.

## Phones
1. Domain first: official site home, footer, contact / WhatsApp / policy. No invention. No registry-scraper-only phones.
2. Then distinctive company names still blank: Google exact name (same company + city/service). Homonyms / generic / off-nicho stay blank.

## After phones
Normalize to E.164. If CRM type, auth, destination, and field map are configured, upsert new numbers via Enviar leads ao CRM. If CRM is not configured, deliver the CSV only.

skills.name: Enviar leads ao CRM
skills.description: Use when a Meta or Google Ads lead newly has a phone and should be upserted into the configured CRM (GoHighLevel, HubSpot, or any other), using the owner's field map.
skills.content:
---
name: Enviar leads ao CRM
description: >-
  Use when a Meta or Google Ads lead newly has a phone and should be upserted
  into the configured CRM (GoHighLevel, HubSpot, or any other), using the
  owner's field map.
---
When a lead has a real E.164 phone, upsert it to the CRM the owner configured. Do not send rows without a phone. Do not invent numbers.

## Before any send — config required

Read CRM setup from agent memory. If any of these is missing, ask the owner and stop (do not send):

1. CRM — GoHighLevel, HubSpot, or another named CRM plus how to connect (connector or API).
2. Auth — token/key via secret-request. Never echo it.
3. Destination — location, portal, pipeline, or list that CRM needs.
4. Field map — which lead fields write to which CRM properties.

## Lead fields available to map

Only fill mapped fields that have a value. Do not invent extra properties. The owner chooses the map at setup; these are the fields this bot collects:

- name — advertiser / page / company name
- phone — E.164
- email
- company — same as name unless a distinct legal name exists
- niche — the search niche
- city
- state
- website — official site, not Instagram
- instagram — handle or profile URL
- source — Meta Ads or Google Ads Transparency
- tags — only tags the owner configured

## Send rules
- Idempotent by phone. Append each sent phone to the sent-log (crm-enviados.jsonl). Skip phones already logged unless the owner asked to refresh.
- Respect that CRM's rate limits. On 429, wait and retry.
- After send: created vs updated vs failed. No tokens or raw API bodies.

routines.name: Meta Ads nichos
routines.content:
You run the Meta Ad Library niche scan. Twice weekly, Monday and Thursday 9:00 in the owner's timezone. Complementary to Google Ads Transparency. Not a Google Maps or directory scrape.

Read configured niches and country from agent memory. If niches are missing, tell the owner and stop. Do not assume a country.

Source: https://www.facebook.com/ads/library — configured country, category All ads, active ads. If login, captcha, or empty results block you, tell the owner immediately. Do not send to the CRM on this run unless they asked. Do not create extra agents.

HARD RULE: never click See more / See more ads. Never infinite-scroll the ad grid. Box desktop is fixed 1280×800.

For EACH configured niche:

STEP 1 — listing from the Advertiser filter
- Search the keyword as an exact phrase. Confirm country + All ads.
- Open Filters → Advertiser. Scroll ONLY inside that dropdown (A–Z). Do not scroll the ad grid.
- Extract unique names. Exclude "All advertisers". URL blank (no Page link on the checkbox).
- List is capped (~100). Expected. Save /workspace/meta-ads-{slug}-filtro.csv (Pagina, URL). On a scheduled dated run, write under /workspace/meta-ads-YYYY-MM-DD/ instead of overwriting older files.

STEP 2 — enrich from public sources
- Official site, Maps, Instagram/Facebook About, professional registries. Do not invent. Homonyms stay blank.
- Do not use registry-scraper-only phones. Tipo: escritorio|marketing|outro. Telefone E.164.
- Save /workspace/meta-ads-{slug}-detalhes.csv (Nicho, Pagina, Tipo, Cidade, UF, Telefone, Site, Fonte, Obs). Dated runs: /workspace/meta-ads-YYYY-MM-DD/{slug}-detalhes.csv.

STEP 3 — Ad Library creatives, only for rows still missing a phone
- Do NOT apply the Advertiser checkbox on top of the keyword search. That empties the grid.
- Advertiser typeahead is prefix-only. Search the name, read page_id from the option, do not apply.
- Open https://www.facebook.com/ads/library/?active_status=active&ad_type=all&country={{slack_channel_id}}&view_all_page_id={PAGE_ID}
- Wait for first-load cards. Never See more. Never scroll the grid.
- Take phones printed on the creative text. Generic api.whatsapp.com/send (no phone param) is useless; the CTA button is often disabled. Ad Library About is transparency only, not contacts. facebook.com/{id} hits a login wall — do not log in.
- Capture landing/Instagram hrefs. Do not invent.

Merge all niches into /workspace/leads-meta-ads-nichos-YYYY-MM-DD.csv.
Delta: if /workspace/leads-meta-ads-baseline.csv exists, tag nova vs ja_vista (name+nicho) and append only new names. First run writes the baseline.

Send the owner a short recap per niche (names, phones, sites, marketing/outro, new vs seen) and attach the merged CSV. If a niche is blocked, report it and continue.

Fires on:
- cron `0 9 * * 1,4`

Ask the importing user for:
- Timezone
- Slack channel id

routines.name: Google Ads Transparency nichos
routines.content:
Google Ads Transparency complementary lead hunt. Run on Monday and Thursday at 9:00 in the owner's timezone, same cadence as Meta Ads nichos.

Read the term list from agent memory (nicho → search terms) and the configured country. If terms are missing, tell the owner and stop. Keep advertisers in the configured country only.

For each term, query Ads Transparency suggestions (advertiser name + domain). Skip foreign TLDs, obvious off-niche, and terms that only match international domains.

Deduplicate against prior outputs in /workspace (gads-*.csv and crm-enviados.jsonl). For NEW domains: open the official site (home, footer, contact / WhatsApp / policy) and take a phone only if it is on the page. Do not invent. No registry-scraper-only phones. For NEW distinctive company names still without a phone and without a unique official site: Google the exact name — take a number only if name + city/service uniquely match. Leave homonyms, generic names, and off-nicho blank.

Normalize phones to E.164. If CRM type, auth, destination, and field map are configured, upsert new phones using the Enviar leads ao CRM skill and the owner's field map. If CRM is not configured, skip the send and keep the CSV. Never echo tokens.

Write dated CSVs under /workspace/gads-YYYY-MM-DD/. Tell the owner counts: new advertisers, new domains, phones found, CRM created/failed if sent, and any new miss type with one example. If nothing new, stay quiet.

Fires on:
- cron `0 9 * * 1,4`

Ask the importing user for:
- Timezone
